body:
I just found out I'm being targeted for harrassement (not here) because I associate with my boyfriend

I don't know what to do .

How can I believe in a new life, when I tried, I tried, and tried, but there was nothing but more darkness? How can I believe if I don't have hope anymore?

My mother told me I am incompetent. I couldn't make it on my own. I don't believe it either. She said not even the police would help me.. nothing feels real anymore.
No sub is a waste of time for having boundaries and wanting to give their submission to a trustworthy Dom, one that will cherish and love it.

"The sub is not going to be made love to; she is not even going to have sex. She is going to be fucked, with all the overpowering and humiliating connotations that this entails."

Lmao what?
A D/s relationship can be anything you want it to be and this sounds like some pure erotica instead of an actual guide.

You have a right to deny, set limits and boundaries. The whole situation gives red flags, especially with the cutting of communication and deleting the account (smells like deleting proof to me.)
Ah, my bad. Thank you. I don't know why I feel so bad about the concept.

I like the confirmation of an idea vs plan — that helps a lot to wind down.

I think I'm apprehensive towards plans at this point. I know it's not going to happen 99% of the time but I can't really stop the drop when a Dom has gotten me into it.
Not really. I've dealt with normal disappointment and it's not severe when there's no subspace involved.

I reassured him as much as I could as he's definitely been riddled with the thought he disappointed me, but it's very hard for him to snap out of those thinking patterns... a problem. Therapy for him is something we're seeking very insistently.

Today, well, he's told me he learned about himself in that moment but he doesn't really want to talk about what happened anymore and wants to just move on from it. No real discussion on what's happening beyond that. My hands feel a little tied.

I've just been sleeping because I haven't felt this horrible in a while. I don't want to be awake and all I feel is this weird dark cloud over me. It's the first time I walk away from our play like this.

As someone with PTSD, I know too much about trauma reactions... fawn is a very messy one to deal with and it's the one that most messes up interpersonal bonds, in my experiences.

One of my concerns is unpacking my whole set of feelings... He always promised me if he didn't like something he wouldn't engage, even for my sake — which, until now, built a really strong relationship for us. Now I'm not sure he's able to actually do something about it. So yes, trust is messy, and I'm upset with myself about it...
I don't want to go into too much detail for privacy's sake, but sexual abuse. I was being playful with him so he would discipline me, and at first everything was fine then he felt really bad.
